basis: The arXiv schedule and direct OAI prove 400 memberships. The 97 DataCite-recovered identities remain terminal owner-day isolation: DataCite created/updated and submitted_v1 preserve identity/version only, and do not support Candidate, Evidence, Books or no-omission claims.
owner_gate: Positive projection frozen to 400 arXiv direct + 2 institutional events; 97 arXiv identities are terminal owner-day isolation pending official membership evidence or reassignment to another verified owner report.

reusable_owner_batch_method.step_1: Use the arXiv availability schedule to convert the public announcement to Asia/Shanghai.
reusable_owner_batch_method.step_2: Use preceding/following official owner receipts to freeze a contiguous arXiv identifier interval.
reusable_owner_batch_method.step_3: Project only registered categories into the Daily inventory; keep the all-category sequence count separately.
reusable_owner_batch_method.step_4: Use OAI/DOI records only to recover identity/version metadata, never to replace the public announcement owner.
